summary_en: CSRI 17 LLC announced a tender offer to acquire all shares of Kaji Technology at 7,957 yen per share over a 30-business-day period from November 11 to December 23, 2026, with a minimum purchase target of 258,300 shares representing 67.14% of voting rights on a fully-diluted basis.
title_en: Notice of Expression of Opinion in Support of and Recommendation to Participate in the Tender Offer for Shares of Our Company by CSRI 17 LLC
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, Kaji Technology Corporation announced that its Board of Directors adopted resolutions expressing support for and recommending shareholder participation in a tender offer by CSRI 17 LLC. The offer is structured to acquire all outstanding shares and make Kaji Technology a wholly-owned subsidiary of the offeror, resulting in delisting from the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market.

The tender offer price is set at 7,957 yen per share. The offer period runs from November 11, 2026 to December 23, 2026, comprising 30 business days. The minimum purchase target of 258,300 shares would result in the offeror holding 67.14% of voting rights on a fully-diluted basis (calculated using total voting rights of 16,425 units as of September 30, 2026 from the company's semi-annual report filed on November 10, 2026). On a pro-forma basis using the baseline share count, the ownership would be 66.67%.

CSRI 17 LLC was established on October 8, 2026 and is wholly owned by CSRI 16 LLC. The company has no existing capital, personnel, or transactional relationships with the offeror. The Board's resolutions were made with the approval of all unrelated directors and without objection from all unrelated statutory auditors, consistent with measures implemented to ensure the fairness of the tender offer process.
